name: d-mango-pack2
prompt: A locked-off medium shot in a distributor's godown in the morning, the open rolling shutter's soft daylight on the left. A woman in her fifties with a grey-streaked braid, in a teal silk sari, wearing reading glasses, holds a small yellow mango drink pack with its plain back towards the camera and tilts its top slightly towards her to read the date printed there, her lips pressed together, then lowers it a little and looks down at the open carton of the same packs in front of her, thoughtful and a little worried. She does not speak and never looks into the camera. Dust drifts slowly in the soft light from the high windows; nothing else moves. Photorealistic cinematic footage, natural skin, natural hands with five fingers. Audio: the hum of ceiling fans in a large godown, the soft rustle of a carton, distant birds outside, no music, no voices.
